note: Gate B W2 (B05 Post-match Report, draft and completed). fixtureVersion 1 was APPROVED_GOLDEN at revision b9a95c9dbf4289a2727a15bd73375a4dc6381e2e (PR #805/#807, 2026-10-21) — that approval is historical fact, preserved byte-for-byte in each candidate's own `priorVersions[0]`, never overwritten. fixtureVersion 2 (this manifest's current state) is a remediation, picked up during Gate B W3's retrospective review: it does NOT inherit fixtureVersion 1's approval — every candidate's top-level `approval` is `null` again, pending fresh technical and owner review of the corrected revision. See docs/ui-lab/gate-b-w2-candidates/SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md for the full finding-by-finding remediation record (B2-R2 through B2-R7) and BLOCKERS.md for disclosures. fixtureVersion 2 — B5 remediation session: five further findings (B5/R1, B5/R3, B5/R4, B5/R5, B5/R7) corrected in the SHARED SHELL/HOOK COMPONENTS (use-safe-report-lifecycle.ts, safe-post-match-report-shell.tsx) and capture tooling, not the underlying fixture DATA records — fixtureVersion/fixtureSha256 for both candidates correctly remain unchanged (2, same hashes), since rawRecordsForHash is byte-identical. See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md for the full finding-by-finding record. Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (commit fcac097a1) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39695163167, 38 B05 captures (including the new match-details scenario), all hashes independently re-verified. fixtureVersion 3 — R8-1/R8-2/R8-3 remediation: locked-state discrepancy wording corrected (R8-1), addPlayer eligibility + reopen target validation added (R8-2), combination-evidence source records moved into the fixture and now drive the displayed row via the real production derivation function (R8-3, changed both B05 candidates' own hashed content — fixtureVersion bumped, new fixtureSha256 for both). See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md. Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (commit 4447f9c30) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39739258569, 38 captures, all hashes independently re-verified. fixtureVersion 4 — R9-1 corrected a fixture-integrity defect (R8-3's own positional segment contradicted the fixture's pre-existing player-minute records). No production/derivation-engine change; no minute value changed; only the segment model and the dependent minutesTogether field (80 -> 83). See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md. Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (commit 742fc01a9) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39755520981, 38 captures, all hashes independently re-verified. fixtureVersion 5 — R10-1 corrected the R9-1 pass's own unsupported 90-minute duration and inferred substitution/departure (neither backed by an NFF rule nor a real event). Established the real NFF Akershus G11 7v7 format (2x30 minutes, 60 total) as authoritative; all 7 present players now start and play the full match with zero substitutions; the canonical goal chronology is rebuilt against production's own real period-relative matchSeconds contract (final goal's global minute moved 61' -> 55', now within regulation). minutesTogether for the displayed Noah+Sindre row corrected 83 -> 60 as a direct consequence. No production/derivation-engine change. See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md and BLOCKERS.md. Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (branch head 18a0aa34f, after a CodeQL fix for an incomplete-string-escaping finding in the new R10-1 test file) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39768921682, 38 captures, all hashes independently re-verified. fixtureVersion 6 — R11-1/R11-2/R11-3 remediation: (R11-1) validateSegmentSequence() never enforced an on-field count ceiling, and R10-1's own negative test for an 8-player segment asserted it PASSED validation while describing this as proof of rejection; corrected with new validateOnFieldCount()/validateExactParticipantCount() functions and a genuinely-rejecting test. (R11-2) retained narrative (b05Reflection, b05OpponentObservation, b05DebriefAnswers) contradicted the canonical score progression (Slemmestad never trails, neither team leads by two) and the unchanged single-segment positional history (no formation change); corrected to agree with the record, with match_changes.option now the schema's own NO_MEANINGFUL_CHANGE. (R11-3) B05_MATCH_FORMAT and b05RotationEvents were excluded from rawRecordsForHash despite being authoritative; both now included under stable keys, changing both candidates' own hashed content. See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md and BLOCKERS.md. Real CI capture evidence for this final revision (branch head 00825887) is committed in capture-attestation.json: run https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/actions/runs/39829331691, 38 captures, all hashes independently re-verified.

candidates.experienceContractRef: docs/ui-lab/gate-b-w1-candidates/SCENARIO_REGISTER.md row B05 (register CSV not independently re-read this session — see SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md)
candidates.baselineAssetRef: PARTIALLY_CORRECTED_REFERENCE — the shared PostMatchReportShell/PostMatchDebrief composition is still the real, unmodified shipped component; the real PostMatchPage wrapper around it is no longer rendered (replaced by a fixture-isolated equivalent, B2-R5) because it offers no seam to prevent real production mutations from a synthetic match id — see VISUAL_VS_CURRENT.md and BLOCKERS.md
knownGaps: fixtureVersion 1's goal-attribution-gap object did not follow the real computeGoalAttributionGap() contract (B2-R2) — corrected; see report-data.ts's b05CanonicalLiveEvents/b05Goals.

fixtureVersion 1's 'Continue fixture simulation' button swapped React props directly, never checking the real timing-submission-blocker gate (B2-R3) — corrected; completion now genuinely rejects while a period needs timing review.

fixtureVersion 1 rendered the real PostMatchPage, which could invoke real production server actions against a synthetic match id (B2-R5, filed as issue #809) — corrected; no production action is reachable from this candidate.
fixtureVersion 1 exposed combination evidence to the draft state and used season-aggregated opponentDiversity/confidence values on a per-match row (B2-R4) — corrected.
fixtureVersion 1 used fragment hrefs (#matches/#match-detail/#review) as if they were working navigation, and used kickoff as the fixedDateTimeUtc for both lifecycle states (B2-R7) — corrected.

The real production PostMatchReportPageShell + PostMatchPage composition independently renders PostMatchUnresolvedBanner/GoalAttributionGapBanner twice (B2-R6, filed as issue #810); this corrected candidate renders each banner once, which is not a claim that production itself is already fixed.

FootballObservationSection is mocked in this wave's own Vitest component tests (an environment-level next-auth module-resolution failure, reproduced directly) — real and unmodified in the actual rendered page; see BLOCKERS.md

B5/R1: a report could reach LOCKED while the goal-attribution gap stayed open, and the disclosure banner (gated `isDraft &&`, matching real production's own PostMatchReportPageShell exactly) disappeared the moment it locked — looking fully reconciled when it was not. Corrected: the banner now shows whenever `hasGap` is true, regardless of lock state — a disclosed, candidate-only proposed visual correction, not a claim that production already does this. The standard/golden completed path (confirm timing, add the real missing goal with its real minute via the capture script's completeB05DraftReconciledFlow(), then complete) remains fully reconciled, matching completed/fixtures.ts exactly. See SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md and DATA_TRUTH_AND_FIXTURES.md.

B5/R3: only addGoal() checked for LOCKED state; every other mutation (updateResult, removeGoal, addAssist, removeAssist, updateAttendance, addPlayer, removePlayer, confirmPeriodTiming, correctPeriodTiming) did not, and the local id counter was a module-level `let` (not deterministic across mounts), and `complete()` stamped `new Date().toISOString()` (not deterministic). Corrected: every mutation now routes through one central `reduce()` validator (use-safe-report-lifecycle.ts) that enforces lifecycle rules + input validation (player eligibility, score/minute bounds, period/duration bounds) before any state change; a rejected call leaves state byte-for-byte unchanged (verified by dedicated tests, including a replay-determinism test). The id counter lives in state; `complete()` now stamps a caller-supplied fixed timestamp (B05_COMPLETED_AT), never `Date.now()`.

B5/R4: `attendanceSummary` only patched `presentCount`/`noShowCount` over the static fixture snapshot (leaving `totalCount`/`noShowNames` stale after an add/remove/attendance edit); `playerInvolvement` derived its present-participant list from the static `b05PresentParticipants` constant, not the live roster; the header's own `MatchIdentityCard` never reflected an edited Result score, showing the original fixture score even after a real 'Save'. Corrected: `attendanceSummary` is fully recomputed live from `state.players` via the real `summarizeMatchAttendance()`; `playerInvolvement`'s present-participant list is derived live from `state.players`; the identity card is rebuilt live from `state.ourScore`/`opponentScore` (same WON/DRAWN/LOST comparison `buildMatchPresentation()` itself makes). Immutable match history (canonical live events, kickoff, match identity fields other than score) is deliberately left untouched — only genuinely report-derived presentation values are made live.

B5/R5: `breadcrumbHref="#matches"` and `PostMatchReviewTab reviewHref="#review"` remained fragment hrefs even after the top-level 'Back to match' link was fixed in the earlier remediation. Corrected: a new real fixture-backed `b05-post-match-report/match-details` page (mirroring B06's own B3-R5 precedent) is now the real destination for both 'Back to match' and the 'Matches' breadcrumb — verified against the real production destination (`breadcrumbHref={`/o/${orgSlug}/matches/${matchId}`}`, confirmed directly in `src/app/(app)/o/[orgSlug]/matches/[matchId]/post-match/page.tsx`). The real `PostMatchReviewTab` component always renders a working-looking link with no way to omit it, so it is no longer rendered for this one tab at all — replaced with a plain, non-interactive disclosure (option 3: omit and disclose, not fake).

B5/R7: capture-attestation.json is regenerated against this revision's own real, passing CI capture run — see capture-attestation.json's own top-level content and this file's own 'fixtureVersion 2 — B5 remediation' note below.

R8-1: the B5/R1 disclosure fix was incomplete — it reused the real GoalAttributionGapBanner's fixed wording, which instructs completing an already-locked report and mislabels a missing report Goal row as missing scorer attribution. Corrected with a new local GoalDiscrepancyDisclosure component with lifecycle-aware wording and dynamic counts; the real production component remains unmodified.

R8-2: use-safe-report-lifecycle.ts's addPlayer() accepted any non-empty string as a valid player id (no eligibility check, raw id used as the display name); reopen() accepted the full status union, so reopen("LOCKED") could produce an invalid {status: LOCKED, completedBy: null, completedAt: null} state. Corrected: addPlayer() now validates against an eligiblePlayers source (the fixture's own allPlayers data); reopen() rejects any target outside {DRAFT, REPORTED} at the runtime layer.

R8-3: the B5/R6 combination-evidence derivation test's source records (positional segments, goal-attribution events) lived only inside the test file, excluded from the fixture's own hash. Corrected: a new shared/combination-source-data.ts module is the single canonical source both the fixture's own combinationEvidence (now COMPUTED via the real deriveCombinationsFromSegments()) and its derivation test import — never two different synthetic models. Self-corrected a real latent bug in the process: the old hand-written row's positions order ("RCM","LCM") didn't match the real function's own lexicographic sort.

R9-1: the R8-3 positional segment (one continuous 0-80' block) contradicted b05MinutesByParticipant's own pre-existing values (Kasper 68, Elias 22, Noah 83) — a fixture-integrity defect introduced by R8-3 itself, never checked against those existing minute records. Corrected: established the real match duration is 90 minutes (2x45', matching b05TimingReview's own real second-half duration), under which every one of the seven existing minute values is exactly explained by one real substitution (Kasper off/Elias on at 68') plus one early departure with no replacement (Noah off at 83') — no minute value needed to change. Replaced with three real chronological segments; the displayed Noah+Sindre row's minutesTogether corrected 80 -> 83 as a direct consequence. A new participation-consistency test suite (including a negative test) now verifies segments against the authoritative minute records directly.

R10-1: the R9-1 pass's own 90-minute duration and its inferred substitution (Kasper/Elias at 68') and early departure (Noah at 83') were themselves unsupported — no NFF rule or match-specific exception justified 90 minutes, and neither roster change was backed by a real canonical event; the CF slot was also left permanently vacant, and canonical event matchSeconds values were never verified against production's real period-relative contract. Corrected: established NFF Akershus G11 7v7 (2x30 minutes, 60 total, report-data.ts's own B05_MATCH_FORMAT) as the authoritative format; all 7 present players now start and play the full 60-minute match with zero substitutions and all 7 formation slots filled; the canonical goal chronology is rebuilt with real period-relative matchSeconds (production's own documented contract), moving the final goal's global minute 61' -> 55' (now within regulation). The displayed Noah+Sindre row's minutesTogether corrected 83 -> 60 as a direct consequence. New match-format and chronology test suites (including negative tests) verify the format, participation, and event records against this model directly.

R11-1: validateSegmentSequence() never enforced any on-field count ceiling, and R10-1's own negative test for an 8-player segment asserted it PASSED validation while mischaracterizing this as proof of rejection. Corrected: new validateOnFieldCount() (general 7v7 ceiling, maximum-only) and validateExactParticipantCount() (B05's own scenario-specific exact-seven rule, since this fixture declares no substitutions/withdrawals) functions in combination-source-data.ts; the backwards-asserting test is replaced with one that genuinely proves rejection, plus new negative tests for duplicate occupancy, duplicate position, and an unexplained six-player segment under B05's own no-exception rule.

R11-2: retained narrative (b05Reflection.note, b05OpponentObservation.factualSummary, b05DebriefAnswers.team_execution.note/match_changes/opponent_memory.note) contradicted the canonical score progression (1-0/1-1/2-1/2-2/3-2 — Slemmestad never trails, neither team ever leads by two) and the unchanged single-segment positional history (no formation change occurred). Corrected to agree with the record rather than inventing a canonical event to justify the prior wording; match_changes.option moved from the fabricated WE_CHANGED claim to the schema's own NO_MEANINGFUL_CHANGE. Genuinely subjective coaching observations not tied to an observable fact were left untouched. Visible effect: the Debrief tab's real DebriefReadOnly component now shows the corrected team note, match-changes label/description, and opponent-memory text; b05Reflection.note/b05OpponentObservation.factualSummary are not rendered anywhere in this candidate's own page tree, so their correction has no visual effect here.

R11-3: B05_MATCH_FORMAT and b05RotationEvents were both excluded from rawRecordsForHash in both lifecycle fixtures despite being authoritative for this scenario. Corrected: both now included under stable keys (matchFormat, rotationEvents); new regression tests prove changing the format, age group, rotation events, positional segments, or player minutes each independently changes the hash, and that an unchanged copy reproduces the identical hash.
